prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If you approach the object, then take it, check it, and finish.   If you see the object, approach it.   If not, move to random location and scan for object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = MoveToRandomLocation    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObject
	END
